item.title: Trump deletes racist video of Obamas after stark GOP criticism
item.description: President Trump on Friday deleted a video first posted on his social media account late Thursday that included a brief clip of former President Obama and former first lady Michelle Obama depicted as apes. item.title: Faith leaders, authorities call for justice after young mother dies in Auburn Gresham shooting
item.description: Chicago faith leaders and authorities are urging the community to come forward with information after a shooting in Auburn Gresham left a young mother dead. A vigil was held Friday to honor her life.

item.title: Woman set on fire on CTA train discharged from hospital after 2 months
item.description: Bethany MaGee, 26, was discharged from Stroger Hospital after being set on fire by Lawrence Reed on a CTA train, and has thanked the burn team for their exceptional care and support.

item.title: Judge orders man cleared of Bovino murder-for-hire plot be released or given bond hearing by Wednesday
item.description: A federal judge in Indiana has ruled that the man cleared of accusations of offering $10,000 for the murder of Border Patrol Cmdr. Greg Bovino must be released from custody or given a bond hearing by Wednesday.
